product_metadata.title: Quick & Clean [18-Pack] Keurig Cleaning Pods - K Cup Cleaner Pod For Keurig - 2.0 Coffee Machine Compatible, Removes Stains, Non-Toxic and Eco-Friendly - Descaler/Descaling Solution Compatible
features: Get That Fresh Coffee Taste Back - Over time, Keurig (TM) machines build up old grinds and residues, tainting the flavor of your coffee and espresso. Quick and Clean Keurig cleaning pods use a proprietary cleaning formula that cuts through and eliminates these residues, bringing taste back to normal

Lengthens The Life Of Your Machine - Residue built up in the pack holder, funnel & exit needle can eventually cause damage to your machine. Regular cleaning using Quick & Clean's cups restores these elements and enhances the lifespan of your machine. Use in conjunction with a Keurig descaling solution for best results (not included)

Safe & Easy To Use - Completely safe - non-toxic, biodegradable and gentle on your Keurig brewer (1.0 & 2.0- compatible). Easy to use - simply brew one large cycle with the k cup cleaner pod for Keurig, then one large cycle with water-only (discard liquid & keurig cleaner pod)

Incredible Value - With 18 Keurig rinse pods per package and incredible cleaning effectiveness, Quick & Clean's k cup cleaner pods provide 3+ months of cleaning power (based on daily usage). No need to try using soap or non-purpose-specific cleaners on your machine. No mess, no fuss - the easy solution

Please note: This is an aftermarket cleaning product (produced by Quick & Clean). We have no affiliation with or endorsement from any of the manufacturers mentioned. Use in conjunction with descaling fluid, replace filters, and use proper cartridges for best results
